resolution.note: red-first containment test counts only scopes holding its own probe; PR-238 gate unblocked

title: Scope the red-first containment test to its own probe scopes
body:
Outcome: the review red-first containment test asserts that no krn-check scope holding its own detached probe survives, instead of diffing every populated krn-check scope on the host, so parallel gate shards cannot fail it.
Evidence 2026-11-06: PR #238 gate builds PR-238 #1 and #2 (K=4 parallel shards) both failed test/flow/review.test.ts:713 with one foreign `krn-check-<uuid>.scope`; the PR changes only Go executor code.
Proof: a unit test of the scope filter with a fake listing (a foreign populated scope ignored, a scope whose process cmdline carries the probe target reported) is red at base by assertion.
